channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Evarist Bartolo must pay €5,000 in libel damages to former EU agency head
item.description: Magistrates’ court finds 2016 comments by the former education minister about “good governance” and “legal issues” defamatory and not substantially true

item.title: Fgura United captain in induced coma after mid-air clash as teammate discharged
item.description: One of the two players who were hospitalised following a serious head-on collision in Fgura United FC’s Challenge League match on Sunday has been discharged, while captain Dylan Caruana remains in an induced coma, according to reports

item.title: Police investigating death of 11-month-old baby
item.description: The baby was found dead at around 11:30pm on Monday in a home in St Julian's

item.title: Guerrilla Girls to take part in Malta Biennale
item.description: The Guerrilla Girls are joining the list of internationally acclaimed artists who will be taking part in the Malta Biennale, which will open in the coming days

item.title: Two young men handed probation after stabbing, mugging man in Floriana
item.description: The accused, aged 19 and 20, stabbed a man in the leg, stole his bag, and tried to use his Revolut card

item.title: Gozos Qbajjar Battery to be given to Din l-Art Ħelwa
item.description: Constructed by the Knights in the early 18th century, the Qolla l-Bajda Battery formed part of a chain of coastal defences. It remains the only surviving artillery battery of its type on Gozo

item.title: Two-year suspended sentence after Rabat field confrontation involving alleged ‘revolver’
item.description: Man handed two-year prison sentence suspended for three years after admitting to charges linked to a confrontation in Rabat in which a farmer believed a gun had been pointed at him

item.title: France, Greece, UK move military assets to Cyprus amid Iran conflict spillover
item.description: Cyprus is already set to receive a warship and anti-drone systems from France, Greek jets, and a British warship

item.title: Russian shadow fleet LNG tanker ablaze southeast of Malta after suspected drone attack
item.description: Updated • A Russian-flagged LNG tanker is struck in a suspected drone attack in international waters southeast of Malta • German military marine patrol aircraft circling over the vessel

item.title: PA approves zoning of massive Mosta site, paving way for residential and commercial development
item.description: Massive Mosta site, which presently consists of agricultural fields and was added to the development zone in 2006, gets zoning green light for residential and commercial development
